assumptions.scope: Every result produced by the pinned Frama-C, Why3, Qed, and external prover binaries.
assumptions.justification: Executable versions/hashes, complete package sets, runtime libraries and installed analysis data are inventoried. The verification engines themselves are trusted; this project does not prove their implementations sound.

assumptions.scope: Only goals discharged using CVC5 1.3.4 through Why3 1.8.2's cvc5 driver.
assumptions.justification: Why3 automatic detection expects the older CVC5 banner and versions 1.0–1.2. Explicit configuration names the actual binary. A bounded true/false integer calibration passed, but complete compatibility across all Why3 constructs has not been reviewed. The installed driver and every imported support file are hashed in the runtime receipt.

assumptions.scope: Host execution of analyzers and native builds; independent from the kernel target's ABI model.
assumptions.justification: Compiler versions, actual executable/native-library hashes, pinned GMP sources and bootstrap artifacts are recorded. The host operating system and all native build prerequisites are not supplied as a hermetic image. The isolated Graphviz extraction is used only for the required dot version check, not a claim that graph rendering plugins are complete.
